parent_objective: design capability-belief intervention probe after M599 audit

public_gates: design capability intervention probe before actor fine-tuning
reuse M591 hidden variants and M598 capability head
keep PPO promotion and actor updates blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or recurrent modules
do not claim driver improvement from capability prediction movement
do not treat random-hidden sensitivity as self-ID proof
hypothesis: The M598 capability head may reveal belief-level sensitivity to wrong or delayed recurrent histories even though M591 showed action-level insensitivity; this must be tested before actor fine-tuning.
success_criteria: design specifies normal reset delayed wrong shuffled scaled and random hidden variants
design specifies capability prediction distance metrics and thresholds
design specifies artifacts and interpretation rules
design blocks actor fine-tuning until belief intervention evidence is known
failure_criteria: design jumps directly to actor fine-tuning
design claims driver improvement from head-only prediction
design uses capability labels as actor inputs

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write capability-belief intervention probe design; no training.

decision_rule: M600 passes because it pre-registers a capability-belief intervention probe that distinguishes belief-use from action-use before actor fine-tuning.
